title: The PublishPress Revisions: Duplicate Posts, Submit, Approve and Schedule Content Changes plugin for WordPress is…
description: The PublishPress Revisions plugin for WordPress up to version 4.3.4 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher to permanently delete trashed posts, pages, and revisions owned by any user, including those with higher privileges. The vulnerability arises because the plugin does not properly verify user authorization before allowing deletion actions. Attackers can trivially obtain the required nonce from a static action emitted in a redirect header before WordPress enforces capability checks.
